name: Suzuki TS185 / TS250
engine: 183 or 246 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, carb, Posi-Force oil injection
intro: Suzuki's two-stroke trail bikes of the 70s. Oil injection, points and six-volt electrics on many.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
